title: The Distant Wardrobe
author: Wendell Nystrom
blurb: Cyrus Villalobos, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the demolition date arrives.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
